title: The bunk bed room
content: This room appears in virtually every residence I've ever been in in Mallworld. I call it the bunk bed room because obviously. Behind that door in the wall is the most fabulous attic. It's absolutely huge, all wood, full of enticing angles, nooks and crannies, and has a cupola that is apparently sought after and the place to be. The cupola is located on a specific building, but can be accessed from this room wherever it happens to be. This room itself, however, is creepy and I think there's lore within the world about people having died in it. Alas, it is the only way I've found to get to the attic or the cupola.
